1.name: Apprentice Model Restaurant
1.title: Apprentice Guardian
1.note: Can't wait to challenge me, can you?

2.name: Junior Model Restaurant
2.title: Junior Guardian
2.note: Looks like you've become a proper cook, but I'm no pushover!

3.name: Song Sao's Restaurant
3.title: Intermediate Guardian
3.note: Challengers just keep coming. Can you beat me?

4.name: Sariel's Soul
4.title: Senior Guardian
4.note: I haven't seen a cook come to challenge me in years. I'm bored to death!

5.name: Barbelet's Judgment
5.title: Elder Judge
5.note: A cooking duel with me is something many never reach in ten lifetimes!

6.name: Duma the Silent
6.title: Elder Mentor
6.note: You look like a born cook. Nothing pleases this old man more than a duel with someone skilled!

7.name: Gurtug's Will
7.title: Tower Elder
7.note: If there is a next life, I will never set foot in this tower again!

8.name: Akatma's Oracle
8.title: Tower Master
8.note: I gave my whole life to get here and now care for nothing. My only wish is that someone takes my place while I still live!

9.name: Anima
9.title: Former God of Cookery
9.note: All things in this world are but passing smoke! A life of passion ends as a pile of dust!

10.name: Peng Zu
10.title: God of Cookery
10.note: Can you make egg fried rice?
